name: Alden
mood: cream-washed clinical calm with blue confidence marks
summary: A warm editorial healthcare style with white and parchment surfaces, Ink and Stone text, Domaine Display serif headlines, Geist UI text, mist-blue word highlights, sky-blue underline accents, sage pill CTAs, rounded care cards, and almost no shadow.

layout.model: centered editorial container with split hero, rounded care cards, testimonial panels, and soft photo frames

elevation.depth: borders, color fields, spacing, rounded panels, and photography

dos: Use Domaine Display or a refined serif for hero headlines and quotes.
Use Geist or a neutral sans for body text and UI.
Highlight only a few important words with Mist Blue and Sky Signal.
Use sage pill CTAs for the primary action.
Keep surfaces white and parchment with generous 96px section gaps.
Use real healthcare or advisory photography with rounded frames.
donts: Do not use cold hospital blue as the dominant surface.
Do not use sharp enterprise rectangles.
Do not add heavy drop shadows.
Do not use neon or highly saturated colors.
Do not turn the layout into a dense dashboard grid.
